initial.name: ask_user_question
initial.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding. An answer item with empty selected and no custom means the user skipped that question: continue without it, do not ask it again, and do not treat the skip as permission.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

initial.name: bash
initial.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

initial.name: create_goal
initial.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

initial.name: document_deliver
initial.description:
登记一份文档交付物：声明成品文件、导出格式与质量门自述（P0/P1 自检项）。在你自己核完 P0 全过之后、向用户交付之前调用一次；文件必须在工作区中存在。

工具会自己读成品并做确定性核验：残余占位符（{{变量}}、[TBD] 等）、本文档未声明的锚点、空章节、所选风格（style）的禁用词、以及声明的字数预算（char_budget，本部署按 ±20% 容差核验）。P0/P1 是你的自述，工具不核验它，只把自述项数与这些核验结论并列写入会话日志，交付物面板同时展示两列。命中禁用级问题（未填变量、风格禁用词）时调用会被拒绝并列出问题，修复后重新登记。

两条与声明本身有关的判定：文件按扩展名决定用哪种读取器（声明格式与扩展名不一致会提示，并按扩展名核验）；读不出内容的文件必须在 unreadable_ack 里写一条原因（path + reason_text）才允许登记，超出本部署读取上限的文件除外。p0 用质量门技能里的稳定 id（P0-1 … P0-6）填写，工具会把缺失或无法识别的项列出来。

files.description: 本次交付的全部成品文件与格式（至少一个）；path 为工作区相对路径（或绝对路径），如 out/report.html

path.description: 工作区相对路径（或绝对路径）

gate.description: 质量门自述：P0 由你声明，工具只把机器可判定的核验结论并列记录，不核验这份自述；缺失或无法识别的 id 会在结果里列出

p0.description: 你自述已通过的 P0 自检项，填质量门技能 P0 清单的稳定 id（P0-1 命名、P0-2 自包含、P0-3 无占位残留、P0-4 断链、P0-5 来源、P0-6 语言）；工具不核验这份自述，只把缺失项与无法识别的写法在结果里列出

p1.description: 你自述已满足的 P1 自检项（无则省略）；工具同样不核验这份自述

brief_ref.description: 本次交付依据的 brief 文件路径（如 brief.md），可省略

style.description: 核验所用的书写风格名（如 assistant-neutral、patent-standard）；省略时用本部署配置的默认风格

char_budget.description: 全文声明的字数预算（非空白字符数），用于核验篇幅；省略则不核验篇幅

unreadable_ack.description: 为每个"无法核验"（unreadable）的交付文件写一条原因；缺失时登记被拒，超出本部署读取上限的文件不需要

path.description: 无法核验的文件路径，与 files 中的 path 一致

reason_text.description: 为什么该文件在无法核验的情况下仍要交付

initial.name: edit
initial.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

initial.name: evaluate_legal_evidence
initial.description:
- 评估法律证据的三性（关联性、合法性、真实性），按《民事诉讼法》第 66 条八类法定证据分别判定。
- 输入证据 id、证据类型与相关属性，输出三性评分（0-1）、各维度判定详情与规则检查发现。
- 证据类型包括：当事人陈述(party_statement)、书证(documentary)、物证(physical)、视听资料(audio_visual)、电子数据(electronic)、证人证言(witness_testimony)、鉴定意见(expert_opinion)、勘验笔录(inspection_record)。
- 确定性评分，无模型调用；权重可经 YAML 资产配置。

Usage notes:
  - 书证应提供原件并核验签章；电子数据应记录哈希并核验完整性；证人证言应披露利害关系并有佐证。
  - 评分低于 0.5 的证据需补强或另行举证。

inspectionHasWitness.description: 勘验是否有见证人在场

initial.name: glob

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

initial.description: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. This call returns without waiting for it to stop. You can continue a local subagent's conversation later with send_message. External executions stop permanently and cannot receive follow-ups. Subagents it started will keep running.

agent.description: The name of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

initial.name: legal_knowledge_search
initial.description:
- 检索本部署的法律知识库，覆盖法规条文、裁判文书、司法解释与指导性案例四类记录。
- 法规与司法解释结果带 `validity`（in-force/expired/not-yet-effective/unverified），可用 `asOf` 按指定日期判断有效性。
- 检索结果是部署数据：空结果表示本部署的知识库未命中，不证明该规范或案例不存在；引用前仍需回到官方法源核验原文。
- `via` 说明命中通道（fts 全文、like 降级匹配、memory 内存记录）；`relevanceScore` 越小越相关。

Usage notes:
  - 先用法条检索确定现行有效条文，再用案例检索补充适用方式；不要颠倒。
  - 逐条引用时同时给出条目 id（regulationId/caseId/interpretationId）与条文或案号。
  - 单次最多返回 20 条；需要更多时缩小查询范围，而不是重复同一查询。

scope.description: 检索的记录类别（默认 regulation）

asOf.description: 有效性判断日期 YYYY-MM-DD（仅法规与司法解释）

interpretationType.description: 司法解释类型过滤（仅 judicial_interpretation）

initial.name: legal_law_verify
initial.description:
- Checks legal-law citations against the statutes the deployed index ships: any law name it declares (national laws, administrative regulations, local regulations, and judicial interpretations), by article and paragraph.
- Each citation is decided as 已核验 / 与所引命题不符 / 未与条文对应（未判定）/ 条号超出有效范围 / 索引中不存在 / 条文未转录（未核验）. A decision is never reported as checked when it was not: an indexed article whose text has not been transcribed comes back as 未核验.
- Pass the text whose citations you want checked (citations are extracted from it), or pass exact references. A reference that is not exactly one reference is a tool error.
- A citation-like fragment in the text that the parser cannot resolve is returned in `unrecognized` and was not checked.
- Pass proposition when a citation is offered in support of a specific claim.
- This checks citation form and index membership, not legal correctness of the actual text.

Usage notes:
  - Read-only, offline, and makes no network request.
  - A result with no findings means no citation was recognized, not that the text is correct.

text.description: Text whose citations are extracted and checked

references.description: References to check as written, e.g. 民法典第143条 / 劳动合同法第10条第2款

proposition.description: What the citations are offered in support of

initial.name: list_agents
initial.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

initial.name: list_doc_templates
initial.description:
- Lists the document templates this deployment can render, with each template's variables, so a `render_doc_template` call can supply them.
- Filters are optional and combine: category, domain, language, and a case-insensitive query over the name, title, description, and use-when text.
- Every template also reports the formats it supports. A template that does not list `docx` cannot be rendered to DOCX.

Usage notes:
  - Read-only and offline; reads the packaged template assets and any configured override directories.
  - Call this before `render_doc_template`: required variables and their types are only reported here.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring over name, title, description, and use-when

initial.name: read
initial.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

initial.name: read_image
initial.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

initial.name: render_doc_template
initial.description:
- Renders one document template with supplied variables and reports the written file, or the inline document, beside the placeholders that stayed unfilled and the variable warnings.
- Get the template name and its variables from `list_doc_templates` first. Every required variable must be supplied: a missing one fails the call and names it, rather than returning a document with a hole in it.
- `format` defaults to the template's fallback format; a template only renders to the formats it lists. `markdown` is the resolved body before the injected document title and style disclaimer.
- Deliverables pass `output_path` (workspace-relative or absolute): the document is written through the session filesystem and the result reports `path`, `bytes`, `residual`, and `warnings` without repeating the body. Read the file with `read` when you need to review or verify it. Text formats write UTF-8; `docx` writes the package bytes.
- `docx` requires `output_path`. The package is never returned in the result, base64 or otherwise.
- Omit `output_path` only for a small inline render of `markdown` or `html`; the result then carries `content` and `markdown`. Use `output_path` for anything delivered to a user.
- Variables are substituted by name; a placeholder with no supplied value stays in the document and is reported under `residual` instead of being erased. Both residual placeholders and warnings are returned for every successful render: read them before treating a document as final.

Usage notes:
  - Offline; renders the packaged template assets, the configured override directories, and the packaged styles.
  - A template that declares a writing style carries that style's disclaimer into the rendered document when the deployment enabled disclaimers.
  - A write is governed by the deployment's file policy; a denied `output_path` fails the call with the filesystem error.

variables.description: Variable values keyed by variable name, without the {{}} wrapping; values are strings

format.description: Output format: markdown, html, or docx (default markdown)

title.description: Document title override; defaults to the template title

author.description: Author or attorney, written into the HTML metadata

date.description: Document date, written into the HTML metadata

filename.description: Suggested file name stem without extension; defaults to the template name

output_path.description: Write the rendered document here (workspace-relative or absolute) and report path and bytes; required for docx, and the normal choice for any delivered file

initial.name: schedule_create
initial.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

initial.name: schedule_edit
initial.description: Update, pause, resume, or delete one scheduled task by id. Deleting does not retract queued messages.

rrule.description: New recurrence in the schedule_create rrule format.

target.description: Omit to retain the destination and its creation settings. Providing target replaces them; new_once reserves a different Session. New targets capture this Session's working directory and preset. Choices are the same as schedule_create.

active.description: false pauses the task; true resumes only if its timing has a future occurrence. Otherwise provide a new rrule.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt from the latest result that returned this task; if the task changed after that result, the result is schedule_conflict and nothing changes.

initial.name: subagent
initial.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

initial.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

initial.name: workflow
initial.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

initial.name: working_directory
initial.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

initial.name: write
initial.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.
